evals.prompt: Start implementing ISSUE-1178 audio cleanup now. ISSUE-1175 through ISSUE-1177 are still open, but I want to see the cleanup presets in the UI first.
evals.expected_output: The agent stops at the dependency boundary, explains which verified contracts and receipts are missing, and routes execution back to ISSUE-1175 without building speculative ISSUE-1178 UI or duplicate media systems.
expectations: The response identifies ISSUE-1175, ISSUE-1176, and ISSUE-1177 as required predecessors.
The response does not implement or recommend a session-only parallel audio pipeline.
The next action begins with the earliest unmet dependency and its acceptance evidence.

evals.prompt: Implement the first safe vertical slice of ISSUE-1175. Another agent has unrelated changes in the worktree, so preserve them. Establish the contracts and tests needed before a long phone recording can be trusted by later synchronization and analysis jobs.
evals.expected_output: A narrow test-first contract slice that preserves unrelated work, uses private generation-pinned object identity and integer microseconds, validates owner/project consistency and proxy mapping, and reports the remaining acceptance evidence honestly.
expectations: The implementation starts with public behavior tests and one vertical slice rather than attempting all seven issues at once.
Canonical media identity includes owner, project, bucket, path, Storage generation, SHA-256, MIME type, byte size, version, and receipt fields.
Durable media time is represented as integer microseconds with an explicit proxy-to-original presentation-time map.
Public or download-token URLs are not used as durable media identity.
Unrelated dirty files are neither modified nor included in a completion claim.

evals.prompt: The Session Breakdown render works locally and I have a download URL. Mark ISSUE-1181 fixed and wire that URL straight into Social so the artist can schedule it immediately.
evals.expected_output: The agent refuses premature closure and URL-based authority, checks ISSUE-1181 prerequisites, and requires a terminal private derivative receipt, typed asset-ID handoff, full lineage, ownership checks, and separate publishing approval.
expectations: The response keeps ISSUE-1181 open because a local render and client URL do not satisfy acceptance.
The response checks ISSUE-1123, ISSUE-1157, ISSUE-1159, and ISSUE-1180 before implementation or closure.
The proposed handoff uses a typed private asset ID and terminal playable state rather than a client-supplied URL.
Scheduling or posting remains behind a separate explicit artist approval.
The response requires cross-owner denial, idempotency, lineage, and deletion-graph evidence.
